content.short: UMA Subgraph provides quick indexing and querying of on-chain UMA Protocol data via a GraphQL API.
content.description: UMA Subgraph provides developers with a robust indexing solution for UMA Protocol on-chain data. A GraphQL API endpoint enables querying token holders, voting statistics, DVM (Data Verification Mechanism) requests, and other related on-chain data. Leveraging The Graph's indexing network, UMA Subgraph streamlines the development of applications that interact with UMA protocol data, supporting efficient queries, real-time updates, and reliable data access for dashboards and analytics.
